sloka: वहन्तम् किम् तुदसि माम् नियुज्य धुरि मा आहिते ।अनार्ये कृत्यमार्ब्धम् किम् न पूर्वमुपारुधः ॥२-३६-१४॥
transliteration: vahantam kim tudasi mām niyujya dhuri mā āhite ।anārye kṛtyamārbdham kim na pūrvamupārudhaḥ ॥2-36-14॥

translations.english: O brutal Kaikeyi, you fastened me to the yoke and when I am drawing forward, why do you beat me? O vile woman why did you not prevent me in the beginning itself?
